summary: Iteration-5 verified the Emergent-managed Google Auth feature end-to-end. Backend 41/41 pytest GREEN (32 regression + 9 new Google-auth). Frontend Playwright verified: (1) pharmacy-google-signin & patient-google-signin buttons render and navigate to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/auth/callback?flow=<pharmacy|patient>; (2) /auth/callback?flow=pharmacy#session_id=BAD_ID renders <AuthCallback data-testid='auth-callback'>, posts to /api/auth/google/session, backend returns 401 'Session exchange failed', UI shows data-testid='auth-callback-error' + 'Return to Sign-in' retry; (3) AppRouter #session_id hash guard: /pharmacy#session_id=XYZ_TEST renders AuthCallback (does NOT redirect to /pharmacy/auth via ProtectedRoute — race condition guard proven); (4) full onboarding e2e — mongosh-provisioned PENDING_ONBOARDING user + session_token cookie → /pharmacy/onboarding form → submit → POST /api/auth/complete-onboarding → 200 → toast 'Pharmacy verified · access unlocked' → navigate /pharmacy dashboard with 'PHARMACY STAFF · VERIFIED' badge; (5) Autofill regression PASS (/pharmacy/auth → /pharmacy). Backend regression tests for POS FIFO / replenishment / telemetry / OpenFDA / consumer-verify / CSV export all still green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1046 lines — split routers (auth, pharmacy, telemetry, consumer) into APIRouter modules per <code_review_guidelines> (>700 lines rule).

auth_utils.require_user: session_token from Authorization Bearer header is only accepted when the token has != 2 dots — clever but brittle; safer to treat Bearer JWTs and session_tokens with explicit prefixes (e.g. `Bearer session:<token>`) or two separate headers.
/api/auth/logout does not require auth — it silently no-ops when there's no cookie; consider returning 401 to signal the client, though current 200 idempotent behavior is defensible.
google_session: if the Emergent provider omits `session_token` we raise 500 rather than 502 — Body-shape errors from an upstream should surface as 502/504, not 500.
